name: Tanh softcap + smoothing + z-loss
tagline: Bounds logits by $30\tanh(\cdot/30)$, applies label-smoothing $\epsilon=0.1$, and adds a $10^{-4}$ z-loss; eval reverts to plain CE.

key_hyperparams.name: softcap
key_hyperparams.role: tanh softcap magnitude on training logits

diff_from_baseline: Stacks all three baselines simultaneously: tanh-style softcap (vs. softcap_ce's sigmoid), $\epsilon=0.1$ smoothing (vs. label_smoothing's 0.05), and z-loss with the same 1e-4 weight as the z_loss baseline; eval still uses raw CE for fair perplexity.

name: Manual smoothing + scaled z-loss
tagline: Hand-built smoothed-target CE with $\epsilon=0.05$ plus a relatively heavy $0.01$ z-loss; raw CE at eval.
init_recovers: Plain CE during eval; reduces to label-smoothing baseline at z-weight=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines label_smoothing baseline ($\epsilon=0.05$) with a z-loss term whose weight is 100$\times$ the z_loss baseline ($10^{-2}$ vs $10^{-4}$); no logit softcapping. Smoothing is implemented by hand against a uniform-over-other-classes distribution rather than via `label_smoothing=` in F.cross_entropy.

name: Tanh softcap + tiny smoothing + z-loss
tagline: Tanh-30 logit softcap, very light $\epsilon=0.01$ label smoothing, and a $10^{-4}$ z-loss on the capped logits.
init_recovers: Plain CE on capped logits during eval
diff_from_baseline: Differs from softcap_ce baseline by using a tanh cap (modded-nanogpt style) instead of sigmoid; pulls smoothing in at $\epsilon=0.01$ (much smaller than label_smoothing baseline) and matches z_loss baseline weight $10^{-4}$.

name: Margin-gated self-distillation CE
tagline: Builds a detached softmax-T=1.35 teacher and mixes it into the target only when the gold-vs-competitor margin is small; sigmoid-gated $\epsilon$, blended with hard NLL and a tiny z-loss.

key_hyperparams.name: soft/hard mix
key_hyperparams.role: blend weights on smoothed CE vs raw NLL

init_recovers: Pure NLL at eval; near-pure NLL on confident tokens (gate→0)
diff_from_baseline: Differs from all three baselines by using per-token, margin-gated label smoothing with a self-distilled soft target instead of a uniform smoothing distribution; no logit softcap, and the z-loss weight is much smaller (3e-5 vs 1e-4).
